quest.title: Guardians of the Countryside
quest.description: The festival is in full swing, but Zhi of Qingce Village is trying to remedy a herb-related predicament...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: I'll leave those three herbs to you, I still need to deal with other herbs here.

talks.objective: Go and have a look in the wild nearby Qingce Village

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Hmm, we're still running a bit low on herbs...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you planning to go pick some more?

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Yes, I was just about to head out. I always like to prepare a little more medicine than usual around this time each year.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Nothing particularly potent, of course, just the usual stuff used for treating fevers or indigestion.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you just get a prescription from Bubu Pharmacy?

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Bubu Pharmacy is much too far away. It's a long walk from here to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Especially for the children and elderly folks who live in Qingce Village. The journey might be manageable for an adventurer like you, but not for them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: That's why I like to prepare some herbal remedies for minor maladies in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Of course, if someone were to come down with something serious, then we'd have no choice but to get a proper prescription from Bubu Pharmacy... Let's hope that doesn't happen...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: I'll chat with you later, I still have to gather some more herbs, and then I've got to bring them back to have them processed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can help.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Eh? You'd really do that? That would be great! I was actually starting to stress about how long this would take me by myself...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Let me see... I think I still need three different types of herbs...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: One of them is Qingxin, which grows on mountain peaks. It is both nourishing and good for digestion.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Another is Calla Lily, which can be found along riverbanks. They can be used to regulate one's hydration.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Calla Lilies that grow by the riverbanks are the best quality, so that's where I get mine whenever I can. Calla Lilies found elsewhere pale in comparison in terms of medicinal value...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Finally, I'll need some Lotus Heads from the nearby pool. When made into medicine, they can be used to calm the nerves and strengthen the heart. You must be quite particular about when you pick them, though. Get them between midnight and six in the morning for the best effect.

talks.objective: Go and pick Qingxin flowers from atop the summit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've finally found what we need! Hmm, this sure is a unique flower...

talks.objective: Go and pick Calla Lilies from along the riverbanks

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's a lot of slimes. Wait... Where are the Calla Lilies? Paimon doesn't see a single one around here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we've finally got our Calla Lilies.

talks.objective: Pick some Lotus Heads after midnight (00:00 – 06:00)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it! Let's take these Lotus Heads back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second... now doesn't seem to be the right time to be picking Lotus Heads.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Zhi wanted us to pick Lotus Heads between midnight and 06:00, right? We'll have to wait for the right time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: You're back! Were you able to find the herbs I asked for?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got 'em right here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Thanks for all your help. I've also asked Ms. Bai to help me with handling the herbs. Let's go and take them to the mill.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Oh, allow me to take care of these herbs. Once I'm finished, you can take them back and start concocting the medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Thank you. Now, I just need to find a way of making the medicine a little sweeter, otherwise, there's no way the kids will be willing to take it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you always this busy at this time of the year?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Yes, more or less. There aren't many young people in Qingce Village these days, so we have to help out wherever we can.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Being busy for these few days every year is not a problem. Besides, things have already been much easier this year thanks to all your help.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: In previous years, I'd have to spend many days gathering herbs, to say nothing of the amount of time it would take to make the medicine...

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Alright, thanks for your help. I'll go to process these herbs now, and then I'll prepare my Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: I almost forgot to release one last year. Have to make sure I don't forget this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What would you like to wish for?

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Hmm... For everyone in Qingce Village to stay in good health? Yeah, I'll probably wish for something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: But wishes lose effect if you say them out loud, so you're not getting anything more out of me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: These are for you — thanks for your help today.
